2609.37603.title: Independent Verification Paths Are Not Independent: A Case Study of Common-Mode Failure in a Satellite Catalogue Pipeline
2609.37603.paper_summary: A common safeguard for a data pipeline is redundant computation: derive each published number by two routes built on different technology and refuse to exit when they disagree. We report one such gate failing, in a cross-catalogue integrity study of two open registers of Earth-orbiting objects. A gate comparing a set-based Python path with SPARQL queries over the emitted RDF graph printed ALL CROSS-CHECKS AGREE on seven counts. Three were wrong, one overstated more than fourfold (932 against 220). Both paths imported the same constants, which encoded a misreading of the source's status vocabulary, so the error was common-mode and the gate could not see it. We give the mechanism, an object-level ledger reconciling every figure, and three checks that go back to the source's documentation, measured on the defective code and on its correction. We then checked that correction against each object's phase history, held in a source file the pipeline never read. The correction was also wrong: 42 of its 261 disagreements are artefacts, and none of our three checks flagged them. Finally, in a controlled replication with three pinned models and tools disabled, 72 of 75 paths generated on request as independent checks computed the defective count, 29 of 30 even when the prompt carried the source's own definitions of the codes. The evidence is one pipeline and one defect family. Within it, redundancy verified implementation, and the errors that reached publication were errors of meaning.
2609.37603.paper_summary_zh: 一個數據管道的常見保障是冗餘計算：通過兩條基於不同技術的路徑推導每個發佈的數字，並在它們不一致時拒絕退出。 我們報告了一個這樣的門失效，這是在對兩個地球軌道物體的開放登記冊進行的跨目錄完整性研究中。 一個將基於集合的 Python 路徑與對發出的 RDF 圖形的 SPARQL 查詢進行比較的門在七個計數上顯示“所有交叉檢查一致”。 三個是錯誤的，其中一個高估了四倍以上（932 對 220）。 這兩條路徑導入了相同的常數，這編碼了對來源狀態詞彙的誤讀，因此錯誤是共同模式的，門無法察覺。 我們提供了這一機制，一個對每個數字進行調和的對象級賬本，以及三個回溯到來源文檔的檢查，這些檢查是在有缺陷的代碼和其修正上進行的。 然後，我們檢查了該修正與每個物體的相位歷史的對應關係，這些歷史保存在管道從未讀取的源文件中。 該修正也是錯誤的：261 個不一致中有 42 個是人工製品，且我們的三個檢查都未標記它們。 最後，在一個受控重複實驗中，使用三個固定模型並禁用工具，75 梯形路徑中有 72 梯形路徑作為獨立檢查生成的計算了有缺陷的計數，即使在提示中帶有來源自己的代碼定義時，30 梯形路徑中有 29 梯形路徑也是如此。 證據顯示一個管道和一個缺陷家族。 在其中，冗餘驗證了實施，而達到發佈的錯誤是意義上的錯誤。
2609.37603.author: Fabio Rovai et.al.
